g.text: R1: ECHO to GPIO2; R2: GPIO2 to GND. 5V echo -> 3.0V.

g.desc: R1: ECHO to GPIO2; R2: GPIO2 to GND. 5V echo -> 3.0V.

g.text: Never connect raw ECHO directly to ESP. Use 1% resistors.

g.desc: Never connect raw ECHO directly to ESP. Use 1% resistors.

g.text: C2 near sensor. GPIO1/2 distance-reading firmware still required.

g.desc: C2 near sensor. GPIO1/2 distance-reading firmware still required.

g.text: RUN: USB unplugged, JP1 fitted. PROGRAM: switch OFF,

g.desc: RUN: USB unplugged, JP1 fitted. PROGRAM: switch OFF,

g.text: REMOVE JP1 before USB. D1 alone does not stop backfeed.

g.desc: REMOVE JP1 before USB. D1 alone does not stop backfeed.

g.text: Never connect 2S pack to ESP BAT+ or 5V header.

g.desc: Never connect 2S pack to ESP BAT+ or 5V header.

g.text: Charging: unplug main battery lead from robot; use a 2S

g.desc: Charging: unplug main battery lead from robot; use a 2S

g.text: LiPo balance charger. Exact charger pinout still unverified.

g.desc: LiPo balance charger. Exact charger pinout still unverified.

g.text: See POWER_AND_CHARGING.txt for both battery plugs.

g.desc: See POWER_AND_CHARGING.txt for both battery plugs.

g.text: Follow printed terminal labels, not block positions.

g.desc: Follow printed terminal labels, not block positions.

g.text: Module wiring only; no physical footprint mapping.

g.desc: Module wiring only; no physical footprint mapping.

g.text: Switch is ON/OFF, not safety isolation.

g.desc: Switch is ON/OFF, not safety isolation.

g.text: 4-wire STEMMA QT cable to spare PiicoDev I2C socket.

g.desc: 4-wire STEMMA QT cable to spare PiicoDev I2C socket.

g.text: Same net labels = electrically joined. VIN uses 3V3, NOT 5V.

g.desc: Same net labels = electrically joined. VIN uses 3V3, NOT 5V.

g.text: DATA -> D4/GPIO5; CLK -> D5/GPIO6. No extra GPIO.

g.desc: DATA -> D4/GPIO5; CLK -> D5/GPIO6. No extra GPIO.

g.text: Other OLED header pins unused. See OLED_WIRING.txt.

g.desc: Other OLED header pins unused. See OLED_WIRING.txt.

g.text: Normal run: battery powers ESP + four SG90s | USB for programming only | Camera / mic / Wi-Fi retained
